---

## 1. MARKET CONTEXT

VIX up 3% to 16.29 amid elevated HV ranks (SPY 86, QQQ 100) signals a premium-rich environment for sellers. Tech stocks remain under pressure despite broad indices flat, creating asymmetric opportunity in high-IV names. **Environment: FAVORABLE** for premium selling—collect elevated premiums while IV ranks are stretched.

---
